claims.quote: Vaillant's chocolate gourami, Sphaerichthys vaillanti, is a labyrinth fish that appears to be endemic to the Kapuas drainage in Indonesian Borneo.
The species originates from the Kapuas basin in the Indonesian part of the island of Borneo.
Sphaerichthys vaillanti appears to be endemic to the Kapuas drainage in West Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo.
